name: mrtenochqe
text: I've always used this place for my vehicle's alignment and they always done a great job for many years. Gio is one of the best service advisors. I wouldn't go anywhere to get my alignment done. Highly recommend this place!

name: Leonel L.
text: Ultra clean shop and very friendly people, they gave me a really good price on a wheel alignment for my truck, I'm definitely coming back next time.

name: Nursultan A.
text: Good place to get your tire, balancing, Alignment and more. Always good quality. Ill do all my pickup trucks alignment here, never regret it. Nick Abeuov🇰🇿

name: Joe W.
text: Great experience from start to finish. Honest, professional, and clearly knew what they are doing. Gio explains everything clearly, doesn’t try to push unnecessary repairs, and gets the job done quickly. The pricing was fair, and my truck is running great. I’d definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a trustworthy mechanic!

name: Mike V.
text: Had a great experience here, fair prices and quick repair. Gio was awesome and really helped take care of the issue quick. I was in and out, they were very professional. Would definitely recommend coming here!

name: J K.
text: Exceptional customer service, prices, and quality of work! The boys over at queens ALWAYS take care of my vehicle repair needs in a timely fashion without being price gouged. If you are looking for an honest shop, queens is your place!
